# LZMA SDK (decoder only)

`LzmaDec.*`, `Lzma2Dec.*`, `7zTypes.h`, `Compiler.h` and `Precomp.h` from 7-Zip 26.05
(`C/` in https://github.com/ip7z/7zip), unchanged. Igor Pavlov placed these files in the
public domain (stated at the top of each file). Used by `src/archive/archive_codec.c`
for the archive reader (HANDOFF sec. 110).
